rules.statement: A Buddhist temple incumbent may appoint a particular pupil as his successor by deed or will, even if the general rule involves the line of succession known as 'sisyanusisya paramparawa'.
rules.supporting_quote: "The general rule of succession to the incumbency of a Buddhist temple is that involved in the line of succession known as the "sisyanusisya paramparawa"; but it is open to an incumbent to appoint by deed or will any particular pupil as his successor."
